{{Quote|Welcome to Macula Station, gateway to the Belsavis penal colonies. Feel free to ask me about our correctional facilities.|O5-D6|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] '''Macula Station''' was the main [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was the only official way to reach the planet's surface, as visitors to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world were required to dock at the station and take a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] down to the [[Prison Administration Center]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Belsavis Republic Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for Republic players for the planet Belsavis, and can only be accessed by Republic players with their own ship. Players then can take a shuttle down to the Prison Administration Center on the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />
